# Habblaud visual art

This directory contains selected source files from Habblaud at commit
`faa1a012b5fbf632c66dc6801c5383e53a542406`:

https://github.com/marmottajr/habblaud

The procedural pixel-art engine, exterior sprites, and their supporting types
are used by Autolisty Company's office. The original MIT license is preserved
in `LICENSE`. Habblaud's session reader, server, accounts, terminal controls,
and social simulation are not included.

Autolisty-specific room arrangement, state mapping, and Company controls live
outside this directory.
